_comment: Copy this to .claude/settings.json in your research project to enable framework hooks. Skills installed under .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md are auto-discovered by Claude Code. Stop blocks when a plan is marked .completed but not yet archived; PreCompact reminds to refresh the active plan handoff and capture session learnings. Both hooks CHECK and report — neither pushes text into context, which is the boundary principle 1 draws (audience-and-philosophy.md, in the framework repo). v3.1 deleted the UserPromptSubmit retrieval hook on that rule: method and source docs are now found by grepping their triggers: line, per .claude/conventions/methods.md. If your project still has a UserPromptSubmit entry running retrieve-learnings.sh, delete it — r2p init --upgrade will not touch your settings.json. Evidence invariants are checked by .claude/hooks/lint-research.sh, run manually or from CI rather than on every Stop.
